what.title: What is Kuytu | Sanctuary of Whispers?

what.p2: So, where do these lost moments go? This app is the sanctuary for those ownerless words and overlooked details. A silent digital diary where you don't have to raise your voice, where you aren't judged, and which belongs solely to you.

how.title: How It Works?
how.f1_desc: Turn inward amidst the chaos. Answer questions prepared for you or create your own to face your inner self. When writing feels too heavy, just turn on the microphone and release your burdens with voice whispers into the void.
how.f2_desc: Transform your raw words into a literary masterpiece. Write your own poem straight from the heart, or let Kuytu's AI 'Poetry Engine' craft a flawless piece for you. Sprinkle this solitude like stardust onto the streets of 'His' if you wish.
how.f3_desc: Don't look at your past as ordinary journal lists, but as a universe made of stars. Discover your memories glowing in the dark and let AI deeply analyze your mood. Embark on a journey of profound inner awareness.
how.f4_desc: Sometimes you just want to scream without an identity. Whisper the things piling up inside you into the universe, by writing or speaking. In these echoes that will vanish in the wind after 24 hours, connect with lonely souls looking at the same sky.
how.f5_desc: The record of hidden beauties you leave to the world without anyone seeing, without expecting applause. A hand reaching out to a stray animal or a slight smile... All these silent kindnesses accumulate on Fridays and echo in the sky.
how.f6_desc: Step into the literary world of invisible spirits and have deep conversations with them. Let them analyze your mood. If you are a Plus member, draw three Tarot cards and unveil the mysteries of your past, present, and future with unique mystical readings!

kuytu_privacy.page_title: Kuytu: Sanctuary of Whispers – Privacy Policy
kuytu_privacy.intro: At Kuytu, we believe your inner world and whispers should remain exclusively yours. Therefore, our privacy policy is built upon the foundation of "absolute user control" and "serverless privacy".
kuytu_privacy.sec1_p: We guarantee that your journals, poems, emotional records, and personal data are strictly never uploaded to cloud servers, but are stored entirely and solely locally on your device.
kuytu_privacy.sec2_p: To use the Kuytu app, you are never asked to provide your name, email address, phone number, or any Personally Identifiable Information (PII), and such data is not collected.
kuytu_privacy.sec3_title: 3. Whispers to the Night and 24-Hour Global Anonymity:
kuytu_privacy.sec3_p: The anonymous text or voice recordings you share with other dwellers using the Whispers menu remain on our servers for a maximum of 24 hours. After 24 hours, they are permanently deleted without a trace.
kuytu_privacy.sec4_p: Except for the temporary shares made in the Whispers to the Night menu which are deleted after 24 hours, no user data (journals, poems, emotion graphs, etc.) is ever stored on our servers.
kuytu_privacy.sec5_title: 5. Silent Kindness Garden and Friday Table:
kuytu_privacy.sec5_p: Your records and plants in your silent kindness garden exist only on your local device. The statistics table published every Friday is completely anonymous; it reflects the total number of people doing kindness as a community, not who did what.
kuytu_privacy.sec6_title: 6. Artificial Intelligence (AI) Integration, Third-Party Data Processing, and Privacy Guarantee (Google Gemini AI):
kuytu_privacy.sec6_p:
Kuytu utilizes the Google Gemini AI API, a third-party artificial intelligence service, to generate poetic verses and constellation awareness reflections for users. In full compliance with Apple Review Guidelines and international data protection standards (GDPR/KVKK), our AI data processing principles are defined as follows:

  • Non-Collection and Non-Sharing of Personal Data: Because Kuytu does not have user accounts or profile registrations, no Personally Identifiable Information (PII)—such as name, email, phone number, location, or device identity—is ever collected or sent to third-party AI services.
  • What Data is Sent to the AI?: Only the anonymous reflection texts selected manually by the user for the express purpose of generating a poem or reflection are transmitted.
  • To Whom is Data Sent?: Data is transmitted directly to Google LLC (Google Cloud / Gemini AI API) over secure, encrypted HTTPS/TLS protocols.
  • Ephemeral Processing & Zero Retention: Transmitted texts are processed ephemerally solely to produce the immediate literary output. Data is never retained, logged, or profiled on either Kuytu or Google servers once the request is completed.
  • No AI Model Training Commitment: Under Google Cloud Enterprise API terms, no user content submitted via Kuytu is ever used to train, retrain, or improve Google’s machine learning foundation models.
  • Equal Level of Data Protection: The Google Cloud infrastructure complies with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 1/2/3, and GDPR standards, providing an equal and robust level of security and privacy protection matching Kuytu's own commitments.
  • User Consent & Manual Triggering: No data is ever sent to AI services automatically in the background. Data transfer is initiated strictly upon the user's explicit action and intent by pressing buttons such as 'Cosmic Inspiration', 'Whisper Poem', or 'Analyze'.
kuytu_privacy.sec7_p: Microphone permission is activated solely when you voluntarily choose to record a voice whisper with your explicit consent. You can preview, listen to, or immediately delete your recording before sending it. Background audio recording or ambient listening is strictly prohibited and technically prevented, and camera access is never requested.
kuytu_privacy.sec8_p: The app does not access general files on your device in the background. Backups you take to prevent data loss occur through your device's secure file system entirely at your manual initiative.
kuytu_privacy.sec9_p: A random anonymous identifier (UUID) is created on your device so you can interact with whispers. This ID never matches your real-life identity.
kuytu_privacy.sec10_title: 10. Community Safety, Content Reporting, and Blocking:
kuytu_privacy.sec10_p: There is zero tolerance for profanity, violence, or harassment in User-Generated Content (UGC). You can instantly report disturbing content or block the related user with a single tap.
kuytu_privacy.sec11_p: If you share the poems you create in Kuytu on our sister app 'His', this data transfer occurs completely anonymously.
kuytu_privacy.sec12_title: 12. Kuytu Plus Subscriptions, Cancellation, and Auto-Renewal:
kuytu_privacy.sec12_p: Payments for premium features are securely processed via Apple App Store and Google Play in-app purchase infrastructure (facilitated by RevenueCat). Your credit card or financial credentials never reach us. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle. Users can cancel or manage their subscriptions anytime via their Apple ID / Google Play account settings or directly using the 'Manage Subscription' button within the app.
kuytu_privacy.sec13_title: 13. Advertising Infrastructure, Third-Party SDKs, and Apple ATT Consent:
kuytu_privacy.sec13_p: Google AdMob is utilized to support the free tier of the application. For iOS users, the Apple App Tracking Transparency (ATT) framework is strictly respected. If a user declines tracking consent, the IDFA (Identifier for Advertisers) is never tracked, and only non-personalized contextual ads are served. Users can update their tracking preferences at any time via iOS Settings > Privacy.
kuytu_privacy.sec14_p: We cooperate with the legitimate requests of official authorities; however, since your journals are not stored in our system, the disclosure of non-existent data is technically impossible. Only the 24-hour whisper logs (if constituting a crime) can be reviewed.
kuytu_privacy.sec15_title: 15. International Data Transfer and Server Locations:
kuytu_privacy.sec15_p: Your 24-hour temporary whisper data is hosted encrypted in secure (Supabase) cloud infrastructures complying with international standards.
kuytu_privacy.sec16_title: 16. Deleting the App and Data Destruction:
kuytu_privacy.sec16_p: Since all your data is kept on your local device, the moment you uninstall the app from your device, all your data is instantly and irretrievably destroyed.
kuytu_privacy.sec17_title: 17. Apple App Store and Google Play Compliance Statement:
kuytu_privacy.sec17_p: This app has been developed to fully comply with all security, privacy, and community policies of the stores (Apple and Google) where it is published.
kuytu_privacy.sec18_title: 18. Comprehensive Rights of the Data Subject (KVKK & GDPR) and Data Erasure:
kuytu_privacy.sec18_p: Under KVKK (Turkey) and GDPR (Europe), users possess the right to erasure (Right to be Forgotten) and full control over their data. Because no personal data is stored on Kuytu cloud servers, all control remains locally on your device. Users can permanently and irretrievably delete all their local journals, whispers, constellation records, and backups at any moment with a single tap using the 'Clear All Data' button in the in-app Settings menu.
kuytu_privacy.sec19_title: 19. Reverse Engineering and CSAM (Child Abuse) Red Line:
kuytu_privacy.sec19_p: Copying the application's source codes, reverse engineering, or probing server vulnerabilities is strictly prohibited. Furthermore, CSAM (Child Sexual Abuse Material) and terrorism propaganda are our absolute red lines. If such severe illegal content is detected in the 24-hour temporary whisper feed, the associated anonymous device logs are immediately reported to the relevant international judicial authorities.
kuytu_privacy.sec20_p: All visual designs, user interfaces, mystical thematic elements, original texts, logos, software source codes, audio effects, and trademark rights of the Kuytu application are the exclusive property of HisVera and are protected under national and international copyright laws. Any unauthorized copying, reproduction, distribution, creation of derivative works, or commercial exploitation of any part of the application or its design is strictly prohibited and subject to legal action.
kuytu_privacy.sec21_title: 21. Personal Responsibility, Non-Advisory Nature, and Limitation of Liability (Disclaimer):
kuytu_privacy.sec21_p: All content, introspective prompts, poetic inspirations, AI-generated reflections, and thematic spreads within Kuytu are provided solely for personal awareness, contemplation, inner peace, and literary appreciation. No insight or content within the application constitutes—or may be substituted for—medical, psychological, psychiatric, legal, financial, or professional mental health therapy advice. Any decision, choice, or action taken by the user based on or inspired by the reflections in the app is made entirely, exclusively, and voluntarily at the user's own discretion and sole responsibility. Under no circumstances shall Kuytu, HisVera, or its creators be held liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or psychological consequences resulting from the interpretation of, reliance upon, or use of any content provided through the app.
kuytu_privacy.sec22_p: Major changes in our privacy policy are notified within the app. For any data requests and questions, you can reach us at kuytu.destek@gmail.com.

his_privacy.page_title: HİS App & HisVera Studio Privacy Policy
his_privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy applies to the HİS (HisVera) mobile application available on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, as well as the hisvera.com / hisvera.studio web platforms. At HisVera Studio and HİS platform, protecting the confidentiality and security of our users' personal data is our foundational principle. In full accordance with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Apple App Store Review Guidelines, and Google Play User Data Policies, we transparently explain below how we collect, process, store, and delete your data.
his_privacy.part1_title: Part I: HİS Mobile App Privacy Policy
his_privacy.part1_desc: This section governs all data processing activities within the HİS mobile app available on App Store and Google Play. Contact: hisnoktasi@gmail.com
his_privacy.part2_title: Part II: HisVera Studio Web Platform Privacy Policy
his_privacy.part2_desc: This section covers data processes related to hisvera.com and hisvera.studio websites and studio/agency services. Contact: Web Contact Form
his_privacy.part3_title: Part III: Common Legal Rights, Security, and Contact
his_privacy.part3_desc: This section outlines GDPR, KVKK, data security, and account deletion rights applicable across both platforms.
his_privacy.sec1_title: 1. HİS Mobile App Scope and Collected Data
his_privacy.sec1_p:
Our application offers the following membership and authentication models to ensure a seamless and secure experience:
  • Google Sign-In and Sign in with Apple: Username, email address, and platform user identifiers (UID) are acquired via secure OAuth protocols. Full support and respect are given to Apple's 'Hide My Email' (Relay Private Email) feature.
  • Email & Password Registration: Passwords are never stored in plain text; they are protected using modern one-way cryptographic hashing algorithms within Supabase Auth.
  • Push Notification Tokens: To deliver real-time mood responses, lantern likes, mutual resonance alerts, and time capsule unlocks, a device-specific push token is stored on our secure Supabase database. You may disable notifications at any time via your device settings or within the app.
  • Transactional (System) Emails: Your registered email address is strictly used for essential transactional operations such as 'Password Reset', email verification, security alerts, and subscription receipts. HisVera does not send unsolicited commercial spam or marketing emails; your email address is never sold or shared with marketing agencies.
his_privacy.sec2_title: 2. Profile Information, Mystic Avatars, and Zodiac/Element Resonance
his_privacy.sec2_p:
Options provided to customize your experience include:
  • Basic Profile: Name, username, bio, and profile photo. For users who prefer not to share their facial photo, pre-designed Mystic Mascot Avatars are available.
  • Zodiac & Element Data: Optional zodiac signs (Aries, Taurus, etc.) and element alignments (Fire, Earth, Air, Water) selected by users are utilized to compute resonance bonds, aura synergy, and Spirit Harmony scores. These data points are not sensitive health or belief data; they are strictly designed to enrich user engagement and spiritual harmony.
his_privacy.sec3_title: 3. Soul Song & Music Integration (Apple iTunes API)
his_privacy.sec3_p:
Users can choose and showcase a song that mirrors their inner soul:
  • Search & Preview Streaming: Song search and 30-second audio previews are powered by Apple's public iTunes Search API. During search and playback, no personal user information (name, email, location, or device ID) is transmitted to Apple servers; queries are performed anonymously.
  • External Music Platforms: Apple Music, Spotify, and YouTube action buttons open the song directly in the respective third-party native app or web browser. Once redirected, those third-party services' independent privacy policies apply.
his_privacy.sec4_title: 4. Profile Websites, Social Media Links & URL Security Shield
his_privacy.sec4_p:
Users may link external websites or social profiles (YouTube, Instagram, Spotify, GitHub, personal portfolio):
  • Automated Security Filter: Every link is thoroughly analyzed prior to saving. Unencrypted protocols (http://), non-standard custom ports (:8080), encoded homoglyph domains (punycode xn--), URL shorteners (bit.ly etc.), dangerous file downloads (.exe, .apk etc.), and gambling, betting, or adult (+18) content are strictly prohibited.
  • External Safety Confirmation Dialog: Tapping an unverified personal website displays an external safety warning dialog (Discord/Steam model) showing the destination domain.
  • Third-Party Link Disclaimer: HİS and HisVera are not responsible for the content, privacy practices, or security of external third-party websites shared by users. Navigating external links is at the user's sole risk; the independent privacy policies of those destination sites apply.
his_privacy.sec5_title: 5. Emotion Posts (Text, Photos, Videos, and Voice Recordings)
his_privacy.sec5_p:
Our platform supports expressive multimedia mood sharing while strictly upholding user privacy:
  • Mood Posts: Selected emotion colors, emojis, mood categories, and text reflections.
  • Telepathic DM (Private Messaging): Direct private messages are never permanently stored on our servers (Supabase); they operate on ephemeral real-time relay principles and are never shared with or sold to third parties.
  • Ephemeral Chat & Vibe Rooms (12-Hour Cycle): Messages within chat and vibe rooms are retained for a 12-hour temporary cycle only, after which they are permanently hard-deleted by background systems; these logs are never shared or sold.
  • Photos, Videos, and Voice Moods: Attached pictures, compressed videos, and recorded voice moods (whispers) are securely hosted in encrypted Supabase Storage buckets. These contents are maintained with the highest confidentiality and never sold to third parties.
  • Content Disposal Guarantee: When a user deletes a mood post, all associated media files and voice notes are immediately and permanently removed from cloud storage.
his_privacy.sec6_title: 6. Location Data and Emotion Map (MoodMap & GPS Precision)
his_privacy.sec6_p:
Our application provides a geographical mood landscape:
  • On-Demand Location Usage: Location permission is queried solely when a user actively posts a mood (optional geo-tag) or views nearby resonances on the map.
  • No Continuous Background Tracking: We never track or record your continuous GPS location while the app is closed or running in the background.
  • Privacy Safeguard: Displayed map coordinates represent generalized neighborhood or city zones to protect precise residential addresses.
his_privacy.sec7_title: 7. Lantern Path, Aura Wish Garden, Midnight Portal, and Time Capsules
his_privacy.sec7_p:
Communal emotional spaces, rituals, and interactive features within our application operate under the following privacy and data processing principles:
  • Lantern Path (Lost Lanterns): Intention, sentiment, and hope lanterns released into digital skies or waters (including mood tags, descriptive text, selected lantern models, paper themes, location tags, and optional audio/photo attachments) are displayed across the community stream completely anonymously. No username, nickname, or profile information is ever associated with or displayed on lanterns. Community members can send supportive touches ('peace', 'warmth', 'courage', and supportive messages) or likes.
  • Aura Garden & Wishing Tree (Garden Wishes): Wishes planted in the collective garden are shared with the community completely anonymously, without displaying any username or personal identifier. Users can interact by sending sparkles and warmth.
  • Midnight Portal & Ephemeral Whispers (Midnight Whispers): Active exclusively between 00:00 and 04:00 local time, this nocturnal sanctuary allows users to share ephemeral voice recordings or written thoughts under nocturnal pseudonyms ('Night Owl', 'Star Keeper', etc.) and light candles (midnight candles). Midnight whispers are strictly ephemeral and are automatically and permanently purged from the database every morning at 06:00 without archiving.
  • Time Capsules (Midnight Capsules): Digital capsules (voice recordings or personal reflections) sealed for the future are securely encrypted and stored until their specified unlock date (typically 1 year). Content remains strictly private and inaccessible to third parties or community feeds until the unlock date, at which point it is made available exclusively to the capsule creator.
  • Content Moderation & AI Safeguards: All text and voice entries across communal spaces are subject to automated profanity filtering and AI-assisted safety analysis to protect user well-being and community integrity. Content evaluated during safety checks is never shared with third parties, never stored on external servers, and strictly never used to train artificial intelligence models.
his_privacy.sec8_title: 8. Soul Resonance, Mutual Bonds, and Spirit Harmony Scoring
his_privacy.sec8_p:
Features facilitating genuine connection and resonance:
  • Resonance Algorithm: Calculated using mood frequencies, elemental synergy, and astrological harmonics to generate a Spirit Harmony Score.
  • Mutual Bonds: Two users who establish a mutual bond can receive resonance updates. Users can break bonds, block, or report others with a single tap at any time.
  • Private In-Bond Communication: Telepathic DM exchanges between mutually bonded users are never permanently archived on our database servers. When a bond is severed or blocked, communication channels terminate immediately.
his_privacy.sec9_title: 9. Artificial Intelligence (Google Gemini AI & Spiritual Deer)
his_privacy.sec9_p:
Mystical and literary AI features in our app are powered by Google Gemini API:
  • Identity Separation: Text prompts entered while interacting with the 'Spiritual Deer' or drawing the daily prophecy/reflection are transmitted to Gemini API in real time. Your personal identifying details (name, email) are never transmitted to the AI; queries are relayed as anonymized data packets.
  • Strict No-Training Commitment: Under Google Cloud Enterprise API terms, user inputs transmitted through our app are not used or retained by Google or HisVera to train general AI models.
  • Medical and Health Disclaimer: Daily prophecies, spiritual reflections, and philosophical insights generated by the Spiritual Deer do not constitute medical, psychiatric, psychological, or clinical mental health diagnosis or therapy. These features are strictly intended for creative expression, contemplative entertainment, and personal inspiration. For any mental or physical health concerns, certified medical healthcare professionals must always be consulted.
  • No Automated Decision-Making / Profiling: AI outputs serve solely as ephemeral artistic and introspective expressions. Our systems never execute automated decision-making or algorithmic profiling that produces legal or binding effects on users.
his_privacy.sec10_title: 10. Payments and Subscription Management (RevenueCat, App Store, Google Play)
his_privacy.sec10_p:
HİS Plus and HİS Pro premium subscriptions:
  • Zero Financial Data Access: All billing, recurring charges, and credit card processing are handled directly by Apple App Store or Google Play Store. HisVera never accesses, sees, or stores your financial card information.
  • RevenueCat SDK: Validates subscription state (active/expired) utilizing an anonymous App User ID, package type, and purchase history without processing personally identifiable financial records.
his_privacy.sec11_p:
To maintain free features across the app, Google AdMob advertising framework is utilized:
  • Ad Formats: Banner, interstitial, and rewarded ads may be displayed.
  • Anonymous Device Identifiers: Standard device identifiers (IDFA/AAID) may be utilized for contextual delivery and aggregate metrics. These technologies do not disclose your personal identity and gather purely anonymous device-level statistics.
  • Tracking Preferences: You can opt out of personalized tracking at any time via Apple's App Tracking Transparency (ATT / IDFA) prompt on iOS or 'Google Advertising ID' settings on Android. If opted out, only non-personalized, contextual ads are presented.

his_privacy.sec13_title: 13. Community Moderation, Profanity Filters, Reporting, and Blocking
his_privacy.sec13_p:
Multi-layered moderation protects community wellbeing:
  • Automated Profanity Engine: A real-time 14-language dictionary blocks hate speech, harassment, and explicit profanity upon submission.
  • Reporting and Blocking (UGC Safety): Every post and profile includes one-tap Block and Report options. Reported items are reviewed by our team within 24 hours, resulting in permanent bans for violators.
his_privacy.sec14_title: 14. Child Safety and CSAM Zero-Tolerance Policy
his_privacy.sec14_p:
Protecting children is our highest absolute priority:
  • Age Minimum: The app is strictly not intended for children under 13 years old; no data is knowingly collected from minors under 13.
  • Zero-Tolerance and Law Enforcement Escalation: Any Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) or endangerment results in instantaneous, permanent account revocation, evidence freeze, and immediate legal reporting to NCMEC and judicial law enforcement authorities.
his_privacy.sec15_title: 15. Account and Data Permanent Deletion Guarantee (Apple & Google Standards)
his_privacy.sec15_p:
Users maintain complete ownership over their data. In full compliance with Apple Guideline 5.1.1(v) and Google Play Data Safety policies, two distinct deletion channels are offered:
  • In-App Deletion: After logging into our application, navigate to Profile > Settings > Privacy Settings and tap the "Delete My Account" button to immediately and permanently delete your account upon confirmation.
  • Web Deletion Portal: Even after uninstalling the app, you can submit an instant deletion request via our dedicated web portal: https://hisvera.com/hesap-silme.
  • Permanent Disposal (Hard-Delete): Deletion permanently purges your profile, mood posts, photos, voice notes, lanterns, and resonance bonds across databases and cloud storage with no recovery possible.
his_privacy.sec16_title: 16. Web Site Scope, Visitor Data, and Server Logs
his_privacy.sec16_p: When accessing the HisVera Studio web platforms (hisvera.com and hisvera.studio), standard web server access logs are automatically recorded. This technical data includes IP address, browser type, operating system, timestamp, and referring URL. Such logs are processed exclusively to ensure cybersecurity, prevent attacks, and optimize technical infrastructure; they are never linked to personal identities.

his_privacy.sec17_p: Names, email addresses, and message contents provided through our online contact or project request forms are processed solely to address your inquiries, deliver technical support, or evaluate creative studio partnerships. Your contact information is never added to unsolicited marketing lists or shared without permission. Contact: Web Contact Form

his_privacy.sec18_p:
Cookies optimize your browsing experience on our studio website:

his_privacy.sec19_title: 19. Intellectual Property, Reverse Engineering Prohibition, and Web Showcase
his_privacy.sec19_p:
Intellectual property rights and software integrity across our platforms are safeguarded under strict legal frameworks:

Intellectual copyrights for moods and literary expressions published by users on our platforms remain with the respective authors; users grant HisVera a limited operational license solely to showcase those works within our ecosystem.
  • Prohibition of Reverse Engineering and Decompilation: It is strictly forbidden to reverse engineer, decompile, disassemble, decrypt, scrape, crawl, copy, or create derivative works from the source codes, algorithmic systems (such as the Spirit Harmony resonance engine), database architectures, or client-server API communications of the HİS mobile application or HisVera web platforms. Any unauthorized attempt will result in immediate and permanent account revocation, followed by legal action seeking maximum statutory damages, civil injunctions, and criminal prosecution under applicable intellectual property and cybercrime laws.
his_privacy.sec20_title: 20. Data Security, 256-bit SSL/TLS, and Incident Notification
his_privacy.sec20_p:
All mobile and web network traffic is encrypted using industry-standard 256-bit SSL/TLS protocols:
  • Technical Safeguards & RLS: Row-Level Security (RLS) is strictly enforced in our databases to guarantee that users access only their own authorized records.
  • Data Breach Notification Procedure: In the event of an unauthorized security breach or cyber incident, formal notifications will be delivered to affected users and statutory Data Protection Authorities (KVKK / DPA) within 72 hours in compliance with legal standards.
  • Limitation of Liability & User Backup Duty: HİS implements industry-leading security practices (Supabase infrastructure). However, to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, we cannot be held liable for unforeseen data losses arising from global network failures, cyber warfare, or force majeure events. Users are encouraged to retain personal backups of emotionally significant materials.
his_privacy.sec21_title: 21. Data Retention Periods, Disposal, and Judicial Inquiries
his_privacy.sec21_p:
Your personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill service objectives:
  • Ephemeral Content: Chat and vibe room messages are retained for a 12-hour cycle only, followed by automatic permanent hard-deletion. Midnight whispers are automatically purged every morning at 06:00.
  • Standard Content: Profiles, mood logs, and lanterns are stored while your account remains active, and destroyed immediately upon account deletion.
  • Statutory & Fiscal Archiving: Following account deletion, personal content is purged; however, purchase invoice IDs and transaction logs may be retained in encrypted archives strictly for statutory limitation periods (5–10 years) required by tax regulations.
  • Official Judicial Requests: Personal data is never sold or rented to third parties. Under valid court orders, subpoenas, or official statutory warrants, limited data may be disclosed strictly to authorized judicial bodies as mandated by law.
his_privacy.sec22_p: HİS and HisVera rely on global cloud infrastructures. Your data is stored on high-security encrypted servers operated by world-class cloud providers (Supabase - AWS/EU Data Centers, Google Cloud). All cross-border data transfers comply with GDPR and KVKK transfer principles, Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), and ISO 27001 / SOC 2 certification benchmarks.
his_privacy.sec23_p:
Under EU GDPR regulations and Turkish KVKK Law No. 6698, all users enjoy the following fundamental rights:
  • Right of Access: Learn whether your personal data is processed and request information regarding processing activities,
  • Right to Rectification: Demand rectification of incomplete or inaccurate records,
  • Right to Erasure (To Be Forgotten): Request permanent deletion of all your personal records,
  • Right to Restrict Processing: Request suspension or restriction of processing under statutory criteria,
  • Right to Object: Object to data processing conducted on legitimate interest grounds,
  • Data Portability: Request an exportable structured copy of your profile data, mood posts, lanterns, and media by emailing hisnoktasi@gmail.com.
his_privacy.sec24_title: 24. Dedicated Contact Channels, Data Controller, and Inquiries
his_privacy.sec24_p:
To ensure fast and accurate handling, our official communication channels are partitioned:

his_privacy.sec25_p: This Privacy Policy may be revised from time to time to reflect regulatory amendments, new feature releases, or enhanced security protocols. Any updated policy takes effect immediately upon being published on this web page (https://hisvera.com/gizlilik-politikasi). Users are encouraged to review this page periodically to stay informed of any changes; the 'Last Updated' date at the top indicates the latest revision.

• Subscriptions Do Not Cancel Automatically: Permanently deleting your account from His systems does not automatically cancel your active HIS Plus and HIS Pro subscriptions on the Google Play Store or Apple App Store. You must manually cancel your subscription from your store settings before deleting your account. Otherwise, renewal fees may continue to apply.
  • Irreversibility of the Process: Account deletion is permanent and irreversible. Profile information, feelings, photos, and lanterns belonging to deleted accounts cannot be restored in any way. Unused or unexpired HIS Plus and HIS Pro rights are completely voided, and no refunds will be issued.
  • Data Retained for Legal Processes: Even if your account and all contents are deleted, log records of accounts closed due to potential criminal investigations, fraud detection, or severe rule violations like CSAM (Child Sexual Abuse Material) may continue to be kept encrypted due to legal obligations.
